title: Yang-Mills Theory and the Mass Gap
description: Four-dimensional lattice Yang-Mills theory with any compact simple gauge group G in U(N) has the mass gap m >= arccosh(1 + (kappa_G/(N beta) - 29/2)/12) > 0 at strong coupling beta, and one uniform cube estimate with constant varpi at physical scale l gives every continuum limit the mass gap m >= 16 varpi/(625 e^2 l). The cube estimate along the weak-coupling tuning and a nontrivial continuum limit remain open.
